related_questions.question: How long does it take to get through security at BWI?

text_blocks.snippet: Security wait times at BWI (Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport) vary depending on the day of the week and time of day, but generally, you can expect to get through security within 20 minutes or less. However, some sources indicate that wait times can be longer, potentially up to 35 minutes during peak hours on certain days. For the most efficient security experience, consider arriving early, especially during peak travel times or holidays.
Factors that can affect security wait times include:

list.snippet: Day and time: Security lines tend to be shorter on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday evenings and longer on Mondays during peak afternoon hours.
Number of travelers: Weekends and holidays tend to be busier, resulting in longer lines.
Local conditions: Weather and other unforeseen circumstances can also impact security wait times.

text_blocks.snippet: To ensure a smooth security experience, it's recommended to arrive at the airport at least two hours before a domestic flight and three hours before an international flight. You can also check the BWI Airport website for real-time security wait times before your flight.
Tips for a smoother security experience:

list.snippet: Arrive early: Allow ample time to check bags, go through security, and get to your gate.
Pack smart: Follow TSA guidelines for prohibited items and pack efficiently to avoid delays.
Consider TSA PreCheck or CLEAR: These programs offer expedited security screening.
Check real-time wait times: Monitor the BWI Airport website or other sources for current wait times.
Stay informed: Check for any updates or alerts from the airport or your airline.
